instructions.title: Instructions:
instructions.automaticInstallationNotice: If you chose automatic installation, you can skip steps 1-5.
instructions.step1: If you don’t yet have a FLIZpay business account, please click here to create one.
instructions.step2: Once you have created your account, generate a new API key in your FLIZpay business account and paste it into the “API Key” field below. You can find your API keys in the “Installation” section of your account.
instructions.step4: After approximately five seconds, the page will reload automatically.
instructions.step5: Once the page has reloaded, a green confirmation message will appear at the bottom. Your FLIZpay plugin is now configured, and you can start accepting secure, bank-account-based payments while reducing your payment costs.
instructions.step6Before: Add FLIZpay to your online stores and choose where it appears among your payment methods.
instructions.step6After: to configure its availability and move FLIZpay higher in the list to make it easier for customers to find.
instructions.step7: We also recommend activating discounts for your customers. Discounts can encourage customers to choose FLIZpay and support conversion and loyalty. You can configure discount offers in your FLIZpay business account. Click here.
